notes: Merged from two passes that agree on the three benchmark checks (all kept), the new service (55, topic 28), the new case (61, same six cells), the marital-status change on profile 4 and the deferred-notification stay. disagreement: stay that profile 40 (TAX-1-0040, the nearest tax id to TAX-1-0004) keeps marital_status Married: B has it, A does not; kept as the boundary of the identifier lookup (logged in the requirement). disagreement: the form of the boolean cell on hr_service.active: A writes the predicate '= true', B the JSON boolean true; chose the plain value 1 (the seed stores the BOOLEAN column as 1/0 and the repository's other check files write it so); the meaning is identical, so no value changed (logged in the requirement). The request's last sentence is truncated ('but that will be done later but the.'); both passes read it as deferring the notification, which no listed tool could write anyway, and the stay keeps that decision on record. The policy's case lifecycle (new, in_progress, resolved, closed) does not match this seed's status column (draft, ready, work_in_progress, closed_complete, ...), so the final status follows the benchmark check (closed_complete); 'closed properly, moving through the right steps' is untestable on the final state. The acting user Tommy Jacobs (user 80, admin, profile 80) may create HR services under policy 2; opened_by is not fixed by the request and is left untested. The benchmark's checks join by name; the requirements use ids (service 55, topic 28, case 61) that assume next-in-sequence creation.
